_source: MegaFon brandbook 'Константы бренда', январь 2026 (pages cited); conflicts resolved in favour of the brandbook

notes.night: brandbook p.23 prints HEX 1E64AA but RGB 27·97·172 (=1B61AC); HEX used
notes.berry: template theme had B359FF; replaced by brandbook AA5AFF

chart_series._doc: Order matches the legend dots in chart layouts (theme slots accent6, accent5, accent2, accent3, tx1).

proportions: green dominates (brand green + white is the main identity); purple is the accent, about 4:1 green:purple; additional colours together ≤ 10%, taken from the purple share (pp.20-21)
gradients: only for small objects; purple gradients on green/white backgrounds, green gradients on purple/white; only combinations from pp.24-25

typesetting.yo: always ё where it belongs, upper and lower case (p.31)
typesetting.dash: em dash — with spaces, no line break before it; en dash – without spaces for ranges: 5–6 октября (p.32)
typesetting.thousands: thousands and the ₽ sign separated by a narrow no-break space U+202F: 12 500 ₽ (p.32)
typesetting.hyphen: hyphen only inside compound words, no spaces (p.32)
typesetting.brand_name: МегаФон / MegaFon: two capitals М and Ф, no quotes, may be declined; with 'компания'/'бренд' and in the legal name — not declined, in quotes (p.33)
typesetting.spaces: no double spaces; no hanging prepositions/conjunctions at line ends (p.31)

logo: Logo is built into the cover layouts of the template; do not add or redraw it on other slides. White logo on green is the main combination; green on white for internal communications (p.11).
tagline: Legal text of the tagline block may be omitted in internal media, including presentations (p.15).

styles.green: brand default for covers and key slides (green dominates primary communications, p.20)
styles.dark: black/purple variant from the template; use only when the user asks

chart_series_by_layout._doc: Legend dots drawn in these layouts (theme accent5/accent2 and accent6/accent5/accent2/accent3/tx1); series colours must match them.
